name: smart-vault
description: Agent-agnostic, pure-Rust #![no_std]-core second brain for Obsidian wired into 8b-is/smart-tree, MemNet, and MemPalace. Features aarch64 NEON/ASM primitives, CSR graph analytics (Tarjan SCC + PageRank), mimalloc, parallel BM25+ retrieval, crash-safe SHA-256 transactions, codesign binary signing, and stdio MCP server. Made with <3 from 8b.is-crew.
